messages:
Ravi: Heads-up 1: visitor arriving at 11:15 with a stroller and mobility scooter. They asked about accessible parking and a short ramp for the main entrance. Can we confirm parking and escort?
frontdesk-bot: Visitor pre-reg: Rivera Consulting 1 guest arriving 11:15. QR check-in enabled. Parking request: accessible. Reply 'ok' to assign parking.
Elena: I can reserve the accessible spot by the west entrance. Do we need Facilities to bring the ramp?
Facilities: We have a portable ramp in storage. Can drop at west entrance by 11:05. Who will escort?
Megan: I can escort from reception 11:15-11:45. Also FYI there7s a perishable package coming around 10:50 (catered lunch). postmaster-bot: Package inbound: "Cold salads" for Lina 10:50. Temperature hold in fridge required.
Gabe: For the stroller/scooter, recommend the service elevator (wider). West accessible parking -> ramp -> service elevator route. I'll bring a folding hand truck to help.
Ravi: Perfect, thank you. frontdesk-bot: Parking spot assigned: West-A1 (accessible). Note: Escort assigned (Megan). Ramp request acknowledged. QR check-in link emailed to visitor.
Elena: Quick reminder to front desk: please hand out a bright green visitor badge and a high-vis lanyard for mobility devices. Also log scooter serial # in case we need to move it.
frontdesk-bot: Check-in flow for front desk:
```
1) Ask for pre-register QR or code (displayed in email)
2) Print green accessible badge + high-vis lanyard
3) Log mobility device type + serial into visitor form
4) Offer service elevator route map
5) Escort to service elevator -> confer to host
```
Megan: I'll meet them at the foyer and help up the ramp. Gabe and Facilities, please meet me at the service elevator.
postmaster-bot: Note: Catered box "Cold salads" arrived; stored in kitchen fridge. Label: "Lina farewell". Do not distribute until 12:30.
Ravi: Also, small heads-up: a package marked 'FRAGILE - MICROPHONE' for Demo Team arrived earlier today and is in the mailroom. Can someone bring it to the stage area after 11:30?
Gabe: I'll run it over at 11:35. Can someone confirm stage door code?
Elena: Stage code is 4321 (temporary). Use only between 11:30-12:00. I'll remove access afterward.
Megan: All set on my end. Anyone have mobility gloves? I left mine at home 😉
Facilities: Spare gloves in supplies cabinet B. Also leaving a pair by the service elevator.
Ravi: Thanks team. Updating calendar and sending an arrival note to Rivera Consulting. Will ping if timing changes.
